semantics: Relative opportunity mass for selecting a residential building within the accepted parent geography.
restrictions: Area is a sampling mass proxy, NOT household/person capacity.

semantics: Relative mass among residential fallback areas when no eligible residential building support is available.
restrictions: Fallback only; does not compete at equal priority with explicit residential buildings.

semantics: Physical footprint may proxy relative opportunity mass.
restrictions: Do not write raw m2 directly into canonical attractiveness; transformation is F4.2.

semantics: Presence of one explicit eligible facility provides unit evidence when no quantitative mass is available.
restrictions: Unit presence is not capacity and does not imply equivalence across facility types.

semantics: Area can be retained for diagnostics.
restrictions: Full land-use polygon area must not be used directly as S_ATTR weight in V1 because fallback areas can dominate explicit facilities.

semantics: Raw OSM capacity-like tag, if present, is preserved with provenance.
restrictions: Do not promote generically to canonical capacity; semantic unit/purpose/time basis may differ.
No V1 multiplication area×levels; missing/inconsistent levels and semantics are not yet audited.

semantics: Identity evidence for conservative POI/building duplicate resolution.
restrictions: Must not affect attractiveness or capacity.

semantics: Zone-level POI count may be reported diagnostically.
restrictions: POI count is neither person capacity nor record attractiveness.

semantics: Tag presence establishes A3 compatibility only.
restrictions: Eligibility is not attractiveness and not capacity.

semantics: No direct conversion from footprint/land-use area to people capacity.
restrictions: Requires an independently frozen, purpose-specific conversion model before future use.
